program: T-CAIREM Continuous SetOperator AF-Density Research Program
auditor: Data Provenance & Integrity Auditor (Swarm Worker: integrity)

check_a_ground_truth_provenance.description: Released expert ECG annotations from IRIDIA-AF; official annotation provenance is human-reviewed clinical GT, not model output. Binary 30s target is assigned based on >=50% AF duration with explicit tie-breaking.

check_b_score_normalization.description: Intrinsic metric denominators and raw absolute differences. Unknown/unobserved time is strictly retained as indeterminate; no score normalization fraud or artificial denominator suppression.
check_b_score_normalization.all_absent_behavior: Refuses beat fabrication; returns explicit indeterminate ValueError to preserve clinical denominators.

check_c_result_existence_and_custody.description: All declared input files, manifests, and trained kernel receipts exist and match their cryptographic SHA-256 digests. Deterministic random seeds and frozen receipts prevent silent overwrites.

check_d_executed_metrics.description: Continuous Charitos AF density, binned density, and patient-clustered metrics execute directly over assigned time intervals. No synthetic imputation or heuristic filling.

check_e_test_isolation_and_scope.description: Strict isolation of 32 held-out test patients (131,667 windows). Verified 0 test patient waveforms or feature shards loaded during kernel fitting or model development.

check_f_evaluation_type.description: Real ECG waveforms from IRIDIA-AF ambulatory Holter monitoring; no synthetic beat fabrication.
